title: Stunts 1.1 MCGA platform boundary inventory
scope: Indexed routines with direct DOS/BIOS/interrupt/port access and routines dereferencing the game sprite surface that can target A000 video memory. Ordinary game far pointers are out of scope unless they cross this platform boundary. Evidence documentation only; no replacement implementation.
address_convention: Real-mode image load offsets from evidence/functions.json, not file offsets, physical linear addresses or SDL addresses.
method: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/msc510-codegen.md, build/workers/objmap/REPORT.md and objmap.md, and evidence/toolchain-hypotheses.json.
Reconstructed the load image in memory and scanned indexed extents; function addresses, sizes, source provenance and caller edges are keyed from evidence/functions.json.
Checked apparent IN/OUT/INT instructions against source procedure bodies; linear disassembly can decode embedded tables/data as opcodes.
No compiler/profile experiment, canonical-state edit, or full validate.py run.

global_surface_contract.sprite_descriptors: Original _sprite1/_sprite2 initialize bitmap segment A000h, offset 0000h, pitch 320 bytes, width 320, height 200; line offsets are y*320. Other sprite windows can use allocated far storage.
global_surface_contract.visible_extent: 320*200 = 64,000 bytes (0xFA00) within the 64 KiB A000 aperture.
global_surface_contract.mode_and_palette: BIOS mode 13h is 320x200 indexed color. Palette block is INT 10h AX=1012h with RGB triplets; reviewed routines do not write VGA DAC ports directly.
global_surface_contract.SDL3_contract: Use an 8-bit indexed 320x200 surface, explicit pitch/clips, a borrowed display surface distinct from owned windows, exact AND/OR/transparency operations and readback/save-under. Map palette registers to the SDL surface palette and present through SDL3.

not_found: game routine opening/reading its own EXE
port_summary.qualification: Absence applies to indexed reviewed code; the listed unmapped ranges remain gaps.
